_README: SCRATCH dry-run label file for evidence-engine-spike-1 (labeling-pace measurement). This is NOT the real fixture — do NOT copy into tests/eval/fixtures/queries.json (5 queries breaks the validator's all-or-nothing 0-or-20 rule). For each query: (1) rewrite query_text in YOUR OWN words FIRST, (2) list the chunks a perfect top-10 would contain in relevant_chunks with a grade 0-3 (3=primary answer, 2=direct addressee, 1=one-click context; never list grade-0), (3) ensure >=1 grade-3, (4) record owner_minutes = wall-clock from 'wrote query_text' to 'last grade recorded'. candidate_anchors_from_search are HINTS from a live search_papers run — verify/replace them; author your own grades. Grade against domain knowledge, not the dense ranking.
_protocol: Server is up on corpus_version 4454 (bridgeland-stability). Per query: search_papers(query_text, k=10) -> ranked chunk_ids; get_chunk(chunk_id) for full body. Proof-kind chunks are NOT returned by search_papers (excluded_kinds:['proof']) — for the proof-anchored query, find a kind='proof' chunk_id via var/arxmcp/corpus/chunks/<paper_id>/chunk_manifest.json. Prefer new-style (YYMM.NNNNN) papers; old-style math/NNNNNNN anchors currently fail the validator (m1 blocker B2).
